components.css: :host{--paper:#f4f5f8;--card:#fff;--field:#e7eaf0;--ink:#161d29;--navy:#1f2836;--deep:#141a25;--on-dark:#f4f6fa;--red:#d42a2f;--red-2:#b8232a;--red-on-dark:#ff6b6b;--focus:#2f66d0;--display:"Cal Sans","Avenir Next","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;--text:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif}.ds-steps{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:24px;display:grid;gap:24px;counter-reset:s;background-color:var(--deep);background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,transparent 0 22px,rgba(255,255,255,.035) 22px 23px);color:#c4cbd8;font:16px/1.7 var(--text)}.ds-steps li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:48px 1fr;gap:16px;counter-increment:s}.ds-steps li::before{content:counter(s);width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font:400 20px/1 var(--display)}.ds-steps b{display:block;font:400 22px/1.2 var(--display);color:var(--on-dark);margin-top:4px}.ds-steps span{display:block;margin-top:4px}

narrative.overview:
A calm, phone-first page that reads like a well-sealed floor: smooth paper and graphite surfaces, nothing loud, one hit of the logo's red where the visitor should act. It is Ellie's house calm band style adapted to Kelluc's badge. The logo's black becomes two navies (never black itself), and the triquetra's red becomes the single accent fill.

The page is a stack of full-bleed bands alternating light and dark so each new section is obvious without dividers: a paper header, the client's own flake-finish front steps under a deep navy overlay, paper, navy, paper, deep navy with a faint diagonal line texture, paper, navy, and a textured deep-navy footer. Density is low: one idea per band, short headings in Cal Sans, generous 64px/96px band padding. Shapes are soft and borderless. Motion is limited to one hero entrance, one fade-up and the floating Messenger circle.

Every action leads to Facebook Messenger, so the red fill only marks Messenger-bound or quote actions, the numbered steps and the arrow circles on hover.
keyCharacteristics: Paper / graphite navy / deep navy bands; the ground is never black.
One accent hue (logo red) in five tuned shades, each with a set job.
Cal Sans headings at weight 400, system-stack body at 16px / 1.7.
Pill buttons, 24px cards, 18px rows, 10px fields; no borders on surfaces.
Flat surfaces; the only shadow belongs to the floating Messenger circle.
Hero H1 letter bounce-in, one 12px fade-up, everything static under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red is the only hue on the page. Fills use Triquetra Red with white text; red as text picks the shade for its ground (Ink on light, Signal on dark or photo, Display only for large words on navy). Never put navy text on red.

rules.name: The Never Black Rule
rules.body: The logo's black is translated to graphite navy and deep navy. No surface is #000 or near it.

rules.name: The Accent Word Rule
rules.body: A heading may end in one accent-coloured phrase ("What we *transform.*", "How it *works.*", "you'll *love.*"), on dark bands and in the hero H1. Light-band headings stay all ink.

rules.name: The One Size For Items Rule
rules.body: Anything that is an item in a list (row, step, claim, card caption) uses the Title size. No item invents its own size.

rules.name: The Single Weight Rule
rules.body: Cal Sans is only ever weight 400. Hierarchy comes from size and colour, not bolding.

rules.name: The Flat Surfaces Rule
rules.body: Cards, rows, buttons and fields carry no shadow and no border at rest. Hover never adds a shadow.

rules.name: The Faint Lines Rule
rules.body: The deep-navy texture is `repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 0 22px, rgba(255,255,255,.035) 22px 23px)`: about 3.5% white, never stronger, so it never reads as lines through text. It belongs to deep-navy bands and the footer only.

rules.name: The Arrow Only Rule
rules.body: On hover only the arrow circle changes (fills Triquetra Red, white arrow); the row itself never changes background or gains a shadow. The same pattern serves the "see more of our work" Facebook row on paper, as a solid graphite navy block. One column on phones, two from 760px.

dos: **Do** alternate full-bleed light and dark bands so each section starts with a change of ground; put the line texture on deep navy only.
**Do** use Triquetra Red as a fill with white text, and pick Ink Red, Signal Red or Display Red by ground when red is text.
**Do** keep focus and hover outlines on form controls in Focus Blue (3px, 3px offset), and Signal Red rings on dark grounds.
**Do** use the Title size for every list item and Cal Sans at weight 400 only.
**Do** keep tap targets at 44px or more and inputs at 16px or more.
**Do** route every contact action to Facebook Messenger; the floating circle and the form never show at the same time.
**Do** use real client photos under a deep-navy overlay, `object-fit: cover`, checking text contrast against the brightest pixel.
donts: **Don't** use black, or any near-black, as a surface.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue or a gradient fill on buttons.
**Don't** put navy or ink text on a red fill.
**Don't** use Display Red for small text.
**Don't** add borders or shadows to cards, rows or buttons at rest, or a shadow on hover.
**Don't** change a service row's background on hover; only its arrow circle responds.
**Don't** animate any heading other than the hero H1, and don't hide content at opacity 0 without JS or under reduced motion.
**Don't** raise the diagonal texture above about 4% white.
